author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Michael Kors presented his spring-summer 2027 collection Friday at New York Fashion Week, using graphic stripes, sculptural shapes and bright accents in a show staged at the Museum of Modern Art's sculpture garden.

The collection moved between casual and formal warm-weather clothing, including one-shoulder evening gowns, professional two-piece sets and striped summer dresses. Black and white dominated the palette, with red, green and yellow adding color. Many looks were paired with the designer's signature handbags. Guests included actors Gabrielle Union-Wade, Grace Van Patten and Lea Michele.

The runway arrives during a business reset for the Michael Kors brand. Parent company Capri Holdings lowered its annual revenue forecast last month, citing inventory delays and softer demand for expensive handbags and accessories. Michael Kors revenue fell to $590 million in the quarter ended June 27 from $635 million a year earlier, its 15th consecutive quarter of declining sales. Capri has reduced promotions, updated stores and invested in new products as it tries to rebuild full-price demand. New York Fashion Week runs through September 15.
dek: The designer's spring-summer 2027 collection drew on the Museum of Modern Art sculpture garden with crisp shapes and vivid color.
headline: Michael Kors brings graphic stripes to New York Fashion Week
